title: 2 New Honda SUVs Coming in December – Hybrid Avancier & Alpha EV
text:
2 New Honda SUVs Coming in December – Hybrid Avancier & Alpha EV Search Maruti Swift Hyundai Creta Tata Nexon Mahindra Scorpio Toyota Innova 
 NEW CARS NEWS & REVIEWS COMPARE CARS FINANCE 2 New Honda SUVs Coming in December – Hybrid Avancier & Alpha EV
 Published By Chhavi | 2026-11-15 Follow us on: The new Avancier will make its global debut in Thailand on December 1.
The Avancier will feature Honda’s new-gen hybrid technology.
Alpha EV is expected to be offered with two battery pack options. 
It will rival the Hyundai Creta Electric and Maruti e Vitara.
 The Japanese automaker, Honda is all set to unveil its two all-new global models – the Honda Avancier and the Honda Alpha electric SUV. Interestingly, the Avancier will be one of first Honda’s models to feature the brand’s next-generation hybrid technology. It’s scheduled to make its debut in Thailand on December 1, 2026. However, the three-row SUV will not make its way to India. The Honda Alpha EV, on the other hand, will make its official debut in India on December 2, 2026.
 Here’re the key details of these two upcoming Honda SUVs. 
New Honda Avancier
In the company’s global product lineup, the Honda Avancier SUV will be positioned above the CR-V and rival the Toyota Fortuner, Hyundai Santa Fe, Kia Sorento, Skoda Kodiaq and Mazda CX-80. While the official powertrain specifications are yet to be revealed, the 7-seater SUV is expected to feature a 2.0-litre, four-cylinder direct-injection engine paired with two electric motors. It could be offered with an all-wheel drive (AWD) configuration.
The official teasers confirm that the upcoming Honda Avancier will feature narrow headlamp clusters, vertically stacked taillamps with a horizontal red-light strip and a sloping rear windscreen. Other design highlights could include slim LED DRLs with an animated lighting sequence, a H-shaped signature with Honda’s new emblem and Avancier lettering. The SUV is expected to measure around 4,960mm in length, 1,950mm in width and 1,690mm in height.
Honda Alpha EV
Based on the Honda 0 Alpha concept, the upcoming Honda electric SUV will be manufactured at the company’s Tapukara facility in Rajasthan. Its powertrain specifications are still under wraps. However, reports suggest that the SUV will be offered with LFP (lithium iron phosphate) battery pack options, with capacities ranging between 65kWh and 75kWh. These could be paired with a single electric motor and a front-wheel drive (FWD) system.
Spy images hint that the production-ready Honda Alpha EV will stay true to its concept. It will retain the MVP-ish proportions while featuring a distinctive SUV stance. Following Honda’s ‘Thin, Light and Wise’ design language, the EV will feature sharply raked front and vertical rear windscreens, front grille with an illuminated Honda logo and a charging port, uniquely designed headlamps, thick C-pillar and 19-inch five-spoke alloy wheels. Other expected design highlights include a rear bumper with integrated small light units and an oversized faux bash plate and full-width U-shaped taillamps.
Upon launch, the Honda Alpha EV will compete with the Hyundai Creta Electric, Maruti Suzuki e Vitara, Toyota Ebella, Tata Sierra EV and Mahindra BE 6.
